Interesting result for GSM8K cross-family:
- N=28 (24 Qwen + 4 Llama)
- γ = -0.1099 [-0.52, 0.28] — essentially zero, CI includes zero
- Good diagnostics: Rhat=1.01, ESS=1554, 0 divergences
